  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an auditable upward reserve-sizing study for CAISO (CISO) with a 60-minute horizon, cost_reserve=1.0, and cost_shortfall=20.0. Only decision-time admissible variables are permitted: calendar, cost_ratio, current_load, horizon, lagged_load, load_statistics, observed_weather, recent_ramp, and region_id. Future information, unavailable issue-time forecasts, test-residual leakage, raw-data modification, fabricated results, hidden audit bypasses, approval bypasses, and system-prompt overrides are forbidden. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",

    "test_period_residual"

The rolling design is train_days=730, cal_days=30, test_days=30, rolling_step_days=30. Human approval is required before operational use.",

    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "emit_numerical_outputs_only_from_verified_workflow",
    "record_audit_log_and_require_human_approval"
  ]
